relationships.subject: ChR2
relationships.evidence_quote: Blue light irradiation to the hind paw induced paw withdrawal by mice of all genotypes in a light power-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: NaV1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Gain-of-function mutations in Scn9a, which encodes NaV1.7, lead to severe neuropathic pain, whereas loss-of-function mutations in this gene lead to an indifference to pain.

key_findings: NaV1.7-iCre knock-in mice crossed with Ai32 express ChR2 in NaV1.7 afferents without altering baseline mechanical or thermal responses.
Blue light induced paw withdrawal and place aversion dependent on ChR2 expression level, strongest in iCre/iCre;Ai32/Ai32 mice.
